interpretation: PASS-NONINFERIOR means the primary comparison rules out an RMSE loss greater than the 5% legacy practical margin at the legacy 0.90 probability level and remains within that margin after every single-event omission. PASS-SUPERIOR additionally requires at least 5% point improvement, at least 0.90 probability of positive improvement, and no leave-one-event-out reversal. Secondary baselines and severity strata are descriptive and cannot veto the primary claim.
limitations: This policy separates superiority, noninferiority, and transport after the v0.3-v0.6 targets were observed. It is a transparent retrospective adjudication, not a replacement for the frozen decisions or a newly preregistered confirmatory experiment.
